name: Hotel Alpin Tyrol
beschreibung: The Hotel Alpin Tyrol is located in an idyllic region of Tirol, not far from the Austrian border. The accommodation offers various room types, including family rooms and suites. Amenities include an indoor pool, a sauna, and a fitness room. The hotel's own restaurant serves traditional Tiroler Spezialitäten. The surrounding area offers year-round leisure activities, such as skiing in winter and hiking in summer. A ski rental and a ski school are nearby. Public transport connections are ensured.
